differences.a_observable: A brushed metal texture is visible on the background block to the right of the tiles.
differences.b_observable: The background block to the right of the tiles is flat grey with no brushed texture.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal texture map to the background plate on the right.

differences.a_observable: Deep, distinct soft shadows are visible beneath the 'Subscriptions', 'Retries', and 'APMs' tiles.
differences.b_observable: The shadows beneath the tiles are extremely faint and diffuse, lacking depth.
differences.fix: Increase the intensity of the key light and adjust shadow bias/diffusion to create deeper soft shadows.

differences.a_observable: The blue icons and text on the tiles have a deeper, less saturated royal blue color.
differences.b_observable: The blue icons and text are brighter and more saturated.
differences.fix: Adjust the diffuse color of the blue material to reduce saturation and match the royal blue hue of Video A.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the 'Secure Payments' tile with a more dynamic, tilted angle.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away with a flatter, less tilted perspective.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera's position and rotation to match the closer, more dynamic angle of Video A.

json.highest_impact_fix: Apply the missing brushed metal texture to the background block and deepen the soft shadows beneath the tiles to match the contrast and material depth of Video A.
